```{r}
#load libraries
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

```


```{r}
data_dir <- '/.../Das_Alyona__BT2015050_2015_A1/outs'
seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- Load10X_Spatial(
  data_dir, #directory containing the H5 file specified by filename and the image data in a subdirectory called spatial
  filename = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", #name of H5 file containing the feature barcode matrix
  assay = "Spatial", #name of the initial assay
  slice = "Stage 2", #name for the stored image of the tissue slice
  filter.matrix = TRUE, #only keep spots that have been determined to be over tissue
  to.upper = FALSE,
  image = NULL, #name of image to pull the coordinates from
)
if (FALSE) {
  data_dir <- 'path/to/data/directory'
  list.files(data_dir) # Should show filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
  Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = data_dir)
}
```

```{r}
#data pre-processing
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^MT-") #mit genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL") #ribo genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^HB[^(P)]") #hb genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.mbp"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^MBP")
plot1 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "nCount_Spatial", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot2 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot3 <-VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.ribo", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot4 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.hb", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot5 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.mbp", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot6 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "nCount_Spatial") + theme(legend.position = "right")
wrap_plots(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, plot5, plot6)
```

```{r}
#subset out low quality cells
seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- subset(seurat_object_sp_stage2, subset = percent.mt < 3 & percent.hb < 1)
seurat_object_sp_stage3 <- subset(seurat_object_sp_stage2, subset = percent.mt < 3 & percent.hb < 1)
seurat_object_sp_stage4 <- subset(seurat_object_sp_stage2, subset = percent.mt < 3 & percent.hb < 1)
```

```{r}
#PERFORM z-normalization
```

```{r}
seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- NormalizeData(seurat_object_sp_stage2)
#seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_object_sp_stage2)
seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- ScaleData(seurat_object_sp_stage2)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
seurat_object_sp_stage4 <- NormalizeData(seurat_object_sp_stage4)
seurat_object_sp_stage4 <- ScaleData(seurat_object_sp_stage4)
```

```{r}
#MERGE
seurat_object_sp_stage2$orig.ident <- "Grade 2"
seurat_object_sp_stage3$orig.ident <- "Grade 3"
seurat_object_sp_stage4$orig.ident <- "Grade 4"
patient.merge <- merge(
  seurat_object_sp_stage2,
  y = c(seurat_object_sp_stage3, seurat_object_sp_stage4),
  merge.data = TRUE,
  add.cell.ids = c("Grade2", "Grade3", "Grade4")
)
```


```{r}
table(patient.merge$orig.ident)
```

```{r}
#Z-normalization happens during ScaleData(), which creates @scale.data. This is not merged
#needs to be re-calculated after merging
```

```{r}
#patient.merge <- NormalizeData(patient.merge)
patient.merge <- FindVariableFeatures(patient.merge)
#patient.merge <- ScaleData(patient.merge)
```


```{r}
#join layers before running clustering
patient.merge <- JoinLayers(patient.merge)
```


```{r}
#Dimensionality reduction, clustering and visualization
patient.merge <- RunPCA(patient.merge, assay = "Spatial", verbose = FALSE)
patient.merge <- FindNeighbors(patient.merge, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
patient.merge <- FindClusters(patient.merge, resolution = 0.4, verbose = FALSE)
patient.merge <- RunUMAP(patient.merge, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
```

```{r}
#visualize
p1 <- DimPlot(patient.merge, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
p2 <- SpatialDimPlot(patient.merge, label.size = 9, pt.size = 1, group.by = 'seurat_clusters')
p3 <- DimPlot(patient.merge, label.size = 9, pt.size = 1, group.by = 'orig.ident')
p1
p2
p3
```

#use log-normalized data for DE

```{r}
#Are the markers from GeoMx spatially variable?

patient.list <- SplitObject(patient.merge, split.by = "orig.ident")

# Run per sample
patient.list <- lapply(patient.list, function(x) {
  FindSpatiallyVariableFeatures(
    x, 
    assay = "Spatial",
    selection.method = "moransi",
    nfeatures = 2000
  )
})
```

```{r}
lapply(patient.list, SpatiallyVariableFeatures)
```
```{r}
# Plot top 4 genes in Stage 2
# Access Stage 2 object
Grade2 <- patient.list[["Grade 2"]]

```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

features <- c("TTYH2") # "CLDND1", "EDIL3", "SRCIN1"

plots <- lapply(features, function(gene) {
  SpatialFeaturePlot(
    patient.merge,
    features = gene,
    pt.size = 2, #spot size for genes
    image.alpha = 0.3 # makes H&E lighter (range 0–1)
  ) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
    #ggtitle(gene) +
    theme(
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
})

wrap_plots(plots)
```

```{r}
#enrichment analysis
# Load the packages
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ReactomePA)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
head(stage4_markers)
sig_genes <- rownames(stage4_markers[stage4_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ])
```
```{r}
enrichment4 <- enrichGO(gene         = sig_genes,
                        OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType      = "SYMBOL",
                        ont          = "BP",
                        minGSSize    = 50,
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH")
```

```{r}
head(enrichment4, n=10)
```

```{r}
# Visualize the top enriched GO terms
dotplot(enrichment4, showCategory = 10, title = "GO Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```


```{r}
enrichment4_mf <- enrichGO(gene         = sig_genes,
                        OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType      = "SYMBOL",
                        ont          = "MF",
                        minGSSize    = 50,

```

```{r}
#KEGG Pathway Enrichment
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs for KEGG analysis
sig_genes_entrez <- bitr(sig_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)$ENTREZID
```

```{r}
# KEGG pathway enrichment for upregulated genes
kegg_up <- enrichKEGG(gene = sig_genes_entrez, 
                      organism = "hsa", 
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```
```{r}
head(kegg_up, n=10)
# Visualize KEGG pathway results
dotplot(kegg_up, showCategory = 10, title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```
```{r}
# Reactome pathway enrichment for upregulated genes
reactome_up <- enrichPathway(gene = sig_genes_entrez, 
                             organism = "human", 
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
# Visualize Reactome pathways
head(reactome_up, n=10)
dotplot(reactome_up, showCategory = 10, title = "Reactome Pathway Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```
